## Components

| Component | Responsibility | Tech |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Web app | User interface | React |
| API | Business logic | FastAPI |
| Worker | Async jobs | Celery |
| Store | Persistence | PostgreSQL |
breadcrumb: Overview > Demo Handbook (Auto-generated) > System Architecture Overview

title: System Architecture Overview
text:
## Data flow

1. Client sends a request to the API
2. API validates and writes to the store
3. Worker picks up async tasks
4. Client polls for the result

title: REST API Reference
text:
## Authentication

All requests use a bearer token in the `Authorization` header.

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
     https://api.example.com/v1/items
```
breadcrumb: Overview > Demo Handbook (Auto-generated) > REST API Reference

title: REST API Reference
text:
## Endpoints

| Method | Path | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | /v1/items | List items |
| POST | /v1/items | Create an item |
| GET | /v1/items/{id} | Fetch one item |
| DELETE | /v1/items/{id} | Delete an item |
breadcrumb: Overview > Demo Handbook (Auto-generated) > REST API Reference

title: REST API Reference
text:
## Example response

```
{
  "id": 42,
  "name": "Widget",
  "status": "active"
}
```

Rate limit: 100 requests/minute per token.

title: Getting Started Guide
text:
## Steps

1. Clone the repository
2. Install dependencies
3. Configure environment variables
4. Start the application

```
git clone https://example.com/repo.git
cd repo
npm install
npm run dev
```

Stuck? See the [Troubleshooting Guide](https://ghosalsankhasuvra09.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/~712020e9a524ccaadb48d5894054eb2ad1b6fa/pages/131180/Troubleshooting+Guide).

title: Deployment Runbook
text:
## Deploy procedure

1. Announce in #deploys
2. Tag the release
3. Run the pipeline
4. Verify health checks
5. Announce completion

```
git tag v1.0.0
git push origin v1.0.0
# CI/CD takes over from here
```
breadcrumb: Overview > Demo Handbook (Auto-generated) > Deployment Runbook

title: Deployment Runbook
text:
## Rollback

If health checks fail, roll back immediately.

```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/api
```
